photos.title: Oceanfront condo towers, North Myrtle Beach, USGS oblique aerial photo, August 24, 2011
photos.what: Three tall oceanfront condo towers with blue-and-yellow balconies and pools behind the dunes in North Myrtle Beach, seen from a plane over the ocean, with streets of houses and a water tower behind them.
photos.caption: Oceanfront condo towers in North Myrtle Beach, seen from over the ocean in 2011.
photos.alt: Three tall oceanfront condo towers with pools behind the dunes in North Myrtle Beach, seen from a plane over the ocean, with houses and a water tower behind them

place.sublocation: oceanfront, between Windy Hill and Crescent Beach

photos.author: U.S. Geological Survey
photos.credit: Photo: U.S. Geological Survey, public domain. Credit not required; give it anyway.
photos.provenance: U.S. government photo: USGS baseline coastal oblique aerial survey 11CCH03 (Ponte Vedra, Florida, to the South Carolina/North Carolina border), flown 2011-08-24, photographer Karen L.M. Morgan (USGS). Frame 2011_0824_180542d.jpg from https://coastal.er.usgs.gov/data-release/doi-F7N877XX/data/11CCH03_0824_180500.zip; aircraft position 33.797022 N, 78.710948 W (11CCH03-Photolocations.csv; the position of the plane, not of the buildings). Data release: Morgan, K.L.M., 2017, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7N877XX. The same release as the Crescent Beach and Cherry Grove photos of batch 2026-10-b.

photos.subject_check: Checked 2026-11-01 by the writer: the three towers are Horry County parcels whose legal description begins 'BAYWATCH RESORT HPR' (HPR = horizontal property regime, a condo; 535 unit parcels in layer 24; parcel center about 33.8019 N, 78.7134 W, northwest of the plane's position, the camera's view direction). Census TIGERweb layer 4 places that point in North Myrtle Beach city. The building name is not in the caption; the photo shows condo towers, not one building as its subject.
